title: Home
one_line: The front door: logo, mode carousel, NX MISSIONS and NX CUP badges, and the one red PLAY.
gaps: Ground is teal #163434. It must be bg_menu_emboss like every other menu (bible 5.1).
Carousel cards are 130 x 230 low-resolution art, stretched on phones. Re-export at 3x.
Top-bar coin icon is 25 px and the energy icon 17 px. Both need the 1024 px sources.
The energy pill reads '1822/5' with the FULL label overlapping.
An ONLINE card is still in the carousel. Online play is not built - project law says never label a mode online.
The home frame was built at 402 pt, not the bible's 440. Keep the 1080/402 factor until this rebuild, then move to 440.

anatomy.spec: bg_menu_emboss, cover-scaled, cropped top and bottom, never stretched. Letterbox in ground.base. Optional vignette to ground.deep.
Per shell-chrome: avatar 52 with its frame-tier ring pinned left, coins pill, energy pill (with the regen timer when not full), burger pinned right. 56 tall, never scrolls.

NX MISSIONS on the left, NX CUP on the right, as logotype badges (bible 2.8). NX CUP opens Rankings (decision D5). NX MISSIONS opens Missions. Each takes a notification dot when something is claimable.
LUDO NX logotype, centred, in the upper third.
Mode cards, swipeable, one centred and raised. Cards at 3x. Modes: QUICK MATCH, VS COMPUTER, PASS & PLAY. NO card may say ONLINE.

The one play red on the screen. XL slab, height 66, radius 16, breathing 1.00 to 1.03 (the only idle). Multiplier coin (bible 5.19) on its top-right corner. Opens the pre-match card for the centred mode.
Per shell-chrome: album, friends, HOME, shop, levels. 116 tall, tan300 plate, on the bottom inset.

copy.forbidden: The word ONLINE does not appear anywhere on this screen until real online play ships.

states: Out of energy - the PLAY button goes to the disabled kind and the energy pill's + pulses once. Tapping PLAY opens the energy popup, it does not fail silently.
Claimable mission or reward - notification dot on the matching badge.
First session - the welcome mascot and a single pointer at PLAY. Once only.
Loading player data - skeleton the pills and the avatar (bible 5.23). Never a blank top bar.
motion: PLAY breathes 1.00 to 1.03 every 1.6 s. It is the ONLY idling element on the screen (bible 2.9).
Carousel: snap to card, 220 ms ease-out. The centred card scales to 1.06.
Badges: a claimable badge does a single 1.0 to 1.08 pop when the screen opens, then stops.
data: Coins, energy, level, avatar: the wallet and StatsService. Server-owned at T-A3 - turn off SeedDemoProgress and remove the local energy demo value.

assets_needed.name: Carousel card art at 3x
assets_needed.prompt: Rebuild the mode cards from the kit rather than re-drawing: small-card chassis, item render, live text label. No baked text.

assets_needed.name: Top-bar icons at 3x
assets_needed.prompt: The 1024 px coin_icon_gold and energy_icon already exist in Art/UI/HomeScreen. Re-export at 3x and replace the 25 px and 17 px versions.

do_not: Do not put a second red button on this screen.
Do not use the word ONLINE, and do not claim a real player will be found.
Do not add a second idling element - PLAY breathes alone.
Do not give Home its own background colour. One ground for all menus.
Do not upscale the existing 1x icons. Use the 1024 px sources.
acceptance: Ground is bg_menu_emboss and matches Friends, Shop, Missions, Profile side by side.
Coin and energy icons are crisp at 1080 x 2400 - no soft edges.
The energy pill reads correctly when full and when regenerating. The 1822/5 bug is gone.
PLAY is the only red and the only breathing thing.
Out of energy opens the energy popup rather than failing silently.
steps: 2. Swap the ground to bg_menu_emboss with BackgroundCoverFitter.
3. Replace the top-bar icons with 3x exports from the 1024 px sources; fix the energy pill layout and the FULL overlap.
4. Rename the ONLINE mode to QUICK MATCH everywhere - carousel, copy, and any analytics label.
5. Rebuild the carousel cards from the kit chassis with live text.
6. Put the multiplier coin on PLAY's top-right; make PLAY the only breathing element.
7. Wire NX CUP to Rankings and NX MISSIONS to Missions, with notification dots.
8. Handle out-of-energy, first-session and loading states.
9. Capture at 1080 x 2400 next to a Shop capture and confirm the grounds match. Postflight.
prompt:
Rebuild the Ludo NX Home screen to the bible.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 6.1, 4.2 and 5.1, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

Six things are wrong today and this task fixes all of them:

1. The ground is teal #163434. Every menu screen sits on bg_menu_emboss - that one change is what makes the game feel like one product.
2. The top-bar coin icon is 25 px and the energy icon is 17 px. The 1024 px sources already exist in Art/UI/HomeScreen - re-export at 3x.
3. The energy pill shows '1822/5' with the FULL label overlapping.
4. There is still an ONLINE card in the carousel. Online play is not built, and project law says never label a mode online and never claim a real player was found. Rename it QUICK MATCH everywhere.
5. The carousel cards are 130 x 230 stretched art. Rebuild them from the kit chassis with live text.
6. PLAY needs the multiplier coin on its top-right corner and must be the only breathing element on the screen.

Wire the NX CUP badge to Rankings and NX MISSIONS to Missions, each with a notification dot when something is claimable. Out of energy must open the energy popup, not fail silently.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list - and include a capture of Home next to a capture of Shop, to prove the grounds match.
